description: Negative conformance vectors for the Ingestion-Pipeline contract family v0.1. Each document MUST FAIL validation against its schema, and MUST fail on the JSON-Schema keyword named in `failValidator` (not merely fail somewhere); tools/validate_ingestion_pipeline_examples.py enforces both. These vectors keep the pipeline seam executable: closed objects, pinned contract version, sha256 content-addressing, an addressable (start,end) span, and — the reason this family exists — a const-pinned embedding model and dimension so the estate cannot fork into two silently-incomparable vector spaces.
